name: domino-online
description: Dominó 2v2 en tiempo real con salas privadas y chat de voz

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:https -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit
